parsed_response.concise_technical_rationale: Design intent: V-001 receives multiphase crude and separates gas, oil and free water by density at about 60 psig/130 °F. Gas goes to fuel gas with excess to the burn pit, water goes to water treatment, and oil goes to the Heater-Treater and then V-003. Guidewords (No/None, More, Less, Reverse, Another, Fire/Explosion, Error) were applied to all six source elements, to the inlet and all three outlet paths, and to instrumentation. Coverage is therefore not limited to the most dramatic scenario. Priority reflects severity plus safeguard gaps rather than salience. Four scenarios rely mainly on control loops: V-001 overpressure, low level with gas blowby to the Heater-Treater, high level with liquid carryover to fuel gas and the burn pit, and common-cause instrument error. PSV-101 A/B is the only confirmed independent layer, and only against V-001 overpressure. Start-up without bypass opening is the only source-supported human/procedural item. No organizational factors are asserted. Fire/Explosion is treated as the consequence endpoint of these initiators. Design limits, safeguard logic and fluid data are absent, and SYS-03 is inconsistent, so most recommendations are verification actions. The qualitative risk class is recorded as the final consequence entry of each finding.
explicitly_non_applicable_or_unresolved: Organizational factors (management systems, staffing, competence regime, safety culture): unresolved. The packet supplies no organizational facts (SYS-09), so none are asserted and no finding is classed organizational.
Human decisions other than FWKO start-up without bypass opening: unresolved. They are not source-supported; only generic procedural verification is recommended (N1-18, N1-19).
Reverse pressure as a separate deviation: not applicable; addressed through Reverse flow (N1-08).
Vacuum/sub-atmospheric pressure in V-001: unresolved. The vacuum rating and any credible isolate-and-cool/drain scenario are not described.
E-001 internal leak or tube failure (Another - cross-contamination or high-pressure ingress): unresolved. Exchanger service, media and pressures are not supplied.
Toxic release hazards (e.g., H2S): unresolved. Gas composition is not supplied.
Purging/air-freeing before start-up after maintenance (internal explosion risk): unresolved. Not described in packet.
Maintenance, draining and sampling operations: unresolved. Not described in packet.
Upstream supply system and internal deviations of the Heater-Treater, V-003 and water treatment: outside the Node 1 boundary; only interface consequences are assessed.
Burn pit design (ignition status, flashback protection, separation distance) and identity of fuel gas users: unresolved. Not described.
Solids/sand production and wax/hydrate formation: unresolved. Fluid data are absent; these are referenced only as conditional causes.
Likelihood quantification: not applicable. No operating data, incident history or calibrated risk matrix were supplied; classes are qualitative for prioritisation.
